Every fact on this site must trace to current AWS documentation. If something is
wrong or out of date, this is the fastest way to get it fixed.

## Where

The lesson, question id, or page with the issue (a link or the on-screen text).

## What is wrong

What the site currently says.

## The correct fact

What it should say instead.

## Official AWS source

A link to the current AWS documentation that backs the correction. A correction
without a source cannot be accepted, because the source is what makes it
verifiable.
